title: E7 relevance audit checkpoint form A
instructions: Continue developing the assembly-entrance paragraph. Audit the selected detail and ending without adding facts beyond the practice notes.

parts.prompt: Which sentence should be removed because it is concrete but irrelevant to the paragraph promise?

options.text: Pupils received a card before walking towards either entrance.
Several pupils looked down at the card before choosing their line.
A brass clock above the hall doors had black Roman numerals.
One helper remained available to redirect pupils who entered the wrong line.

choice_rationales.A: This explains when the intervention occurred.
choice_rationales.B: This is a relevant observable response.
choice_rationales.C: The clock is vivid but does not show how entrance choices became clearer.
choice_rationales.D: This identifies how the system handled exceptions.

parts.hint: Protected checkpoint: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: Specificity earns its place only when it advances the paragraph's evidence or explanation.

parts.prompt: Which concluding sentence is the most accurate and useful?

options.text: The trial suggests that a simple signal can move routine choices earlier, though another assembly would be needed to test whether the improvement lasts.
The method permanently ended confusion for every pupil in the school.
The two card colours were equally beautiful.
Therefore, all schools must replace their entrance systems immediately.

choice_rationales.A: This states a bounded significance and an honest limit.
choice_rationales.B: The notes do not support a permanent or universal result.
choice_rationales.C: Aesthetic preference does not conclude the organisational reasoning.
choice_rationales.D: One trial cannot justify a requirement for all schools.

parts.hint: Protected checkpoint: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: The conclusion interprets the trial while keeping its scope proportionate to the evidence.
